narrative:
Chart of Accounts administration — the Gamma planning COA is mapped to the GL accounts in the SQL Server finance and billing databases, now landed in Snowflake, across income statement, balance sheet and cash flow.

AI Auto-Map suggests mappings for unmapped GL accounts using Cortex, with high accuracy on standard telecom accounts such as wholesale access, interconnect, partner commissions and deferred rental income.
